svg.text: MPx-BLM-012/013/014/017 · Lime-trap drawer, catcher, gate, spout
MPx Boil-Loop Mini v0.5 · IISc CPDM · preliminary, not for manufacture
1. P12 body: 316L tube Ø36 × 1.0 × 50; ports TIG-welded: top Ø13.5 boss (boil-coil), rear Ø24 gate pocket.
2. Front bayonet ring 316L, 2 lugs at 180°, ¼ turn; face seal O-ring 30 × 2.5 silicone (VMQ, FDA).
3. P13: 25 µm twilled Dutch weave (165 × 1400) rolled, seam spot-welded, end caps 0.5 316L; knob 316L.
4. P14: wax thermal actuator, opens 92–95 °C, full lift 5 at 100 °C, poppet Ø8 with VMQ seat; buy-in.
front (+y) to the right; flow: top port → mesh → core → gate
mesh area ≈ 21 cm² · rinse after each 3–5 L
